create.name: Dr. Farokh J. Master
create.bio:
Farokh Master left orthodox medical studies in June 1976 to join Bombay Homeopathic Medical College, graduating in 1979 with first-class honours. In 1994 he became, by his own account, India's first MD in homeopathy, taking the degree at MPK Homeopathic Medical College in Jaipur, and he later completed a PhD.

He runs the Homeopathic Health Centre in Mumbai and teaches at Mumbai Homeopathic Medical College, and he is among the most travelled teachers in the field — his seminar archive lists summer schools in more than forty cities, from Toronto and Chicago to Kyoto, Kuala Lumpur, Lisbon and Belgrade. He holds visiting professorships at homeopathic colleges across the UK, Canada, Austria, Hungary, Poland, Norway, Greece, Cyprus, Malaysia, the Netherlands and Germany.

He has written more than sixty books, of which fifty-two are in English, translated into nine languages — a catalogue that ranges from repertory technique and materia medica study method to Bach flower remedies, fairy tales, and provings of individual substances. Outside the teaching, he runs a free clinic and a free veterinary clinic at the Homeopathic Health Centre, the latter operating since 1980, and he is known within the profession for that philanthropic work as much as for the books.

books.title: Bedside Clinical Prescribing in Homoeopathy
books.author: Farokh J. Master
books.description: A practitioner's reference drawn from what Master describes as thirty-eight years of classical practice, organised head to toe across more than five hundred clinical presentations. Written for qualified homeopaths making differential decisions at the bedside, not for general readers.

books.title: Clinical Observations of Children's Remedies
books.author: Farokh J. Master
books.description: A paediatric materia medica built from his own clinic notes, describing the remedy pictures he associates with children at different stages. Written for practitioners.

books.title: Bach Flower Remedies for Everyone
books.author: Farokh J. Master
books.description: His guide to Edward Bach's thirty-eight flower remedies, written for a general readership rather than for clinicians. The most accessible book in his catalogue, and the one that sits most naturally alongside Spiritpedia's other content.

books.title: Understanding Posology in Classical Homoeopathy
books.author: Farokh J. Master
books.description: On dose and potency — how much, how often, and when to repeat. Posology is the most argued-over question in homeopathic practice, and this is Master's position on it, set out with case illustration.

books.title: How to Best Use Boger & Boenninghausen Repertory
books.author: Farokh J. Master
books.description: A technical manual on two of the classical repertories, teaching the logic behind their structure rather than just their use. Aimed squarely at students and practitioners.

books.title: A Proving of Moccasin Snake
books.author: Farokh J. Master
books.description: The published record of a proving he conducted — the homeopathic research procedure in which a substance is given to healthy volunteers and their responses documented. A primary-source document rather than a teaching text.

books.title: Guide to Common Allopathic Drugs for Homoeopathic Practitioners
books.author: Farokh J. Master
books.description: A reference on conventional medications, written so that homeopathic practitioners can recognise what their patients are already taking and what it does. Notable for being one of the few books in the field that assumes patients are under conventional medical care.

books.title: Clinical Organon of Medicine
books.author: Farokh J. Master
books.description: His reading of Hahnemann's Organon, presented as a clinical rather than a philosophical commentary — each aphorism worked through in terms of what he takes it to mean at the consulting-room desk.

courses.title: Understanding Rubrics of Mind, Delusions & Dreams with Farokh Master
courses.description: A two-hour recorded course in which Master works through the mental rubrics of the repertory — how he interprets the language of delusion and dream in case-taking. Drawn from the material in his book of the same subject.

courses.title: Foreign Student Observership at the Homeopathic Health Centre
courses.description: An in-person training placement in Mumbai in which international students sit in on Master's daily consultations at the Homeopathic Health Centre and the hospitals he visits. Translation is provided where patients do not speak English.

courses.title: Indian Student Training Programme
courses.description: The domestic equivalent of the observership, offering Indian students structured clinical exposure at the Homeopathic Health Centre.

free_resources.title: Articles and Editorials archive
free_resources.description: An open archive of his published articles and journal editorials organised by year from 2003 to 2019, with a further miscellaneous section. Freely readable with no signup, and the largest body of his written thinking available at no cost.

free_resources.title: Provings archive
free_resources.description: His published proving records — the documented results of giving substances to healthy volunteers and recording what follows. Primary research material, made openly available rather than sold.
